title: What is a boom lift, really?
lines: A boom lift is a truck with an arm, and a basket for people at the end.
It lifts workers up high safely and fast, with no scaffolding.
Great for signs, air conditioners, windows, tree trimming and facade repairs.
To order right, send the address, the working height and a photo of the spot.
With those details we check the fit before we even arrive.
Ofek At Tal Cranes. Safety first.
